text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days before the race, Tamamo Cross and I visit Nakayama Racecourse to walk the track.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Let's see… So at the start, I'll be 'bout here, and when I hit the curve, I'll do one of these… And on the straights, I can just…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer. Now that I'm seein' it up close 'n personal… This track's pretty decent. Even good for a nice stroll.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ah… What a nice breeze…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She looks uncharacteristically relaxed. I've never seen her this laid-back while checking out tracks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeing her this way, I come to a conclusion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Get ready, people—the forecast's callin' for some White Lightning.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: And here comes the senior champion! The winner of both the Takarazuka Kinen and the autumn Tenno Sho has arrived!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Tama… Her aura is something else…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Is that… the same Tamtam I know?

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Woooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The intensity of her presence cuts through the tension in the air. The venue almost seems to shudder.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Was Tamamo Cross always so… big?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Nah, she's the same as she always was. But I gotta admit… she feels like a giant today.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Oguri, Creek. Today's the day we fulfill the promises we made.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: We talked about it at the end of summer, remember? We wanted to race together again, all three of us.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I-I remember… So…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I won't be spoiling you today, Tamtam. In fact, I'll be doing the opposite.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: You're not the Tamamo Cross I know… Tama, you're…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: …This is the real me, Oguri. I've just been pullin' my punches till now.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Guess you could say I didn't have anythin' anchorin' me. I was like lightnin' without the storm clouds, ya know? Just crashin' into the ground. One 'n done.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: That's not the case anymore. I've got someone to pull me back into the storm clouds, and White Lightning's been fully charged. Heck, maybe even overcharged.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: It's like my whole body's… cracklin' with energy. I feel like I could explode any moment. And with this body—this newfound feelin'…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna blow ya away, Oguri. I'm gonna leave ya behind in the blink of an eye.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The famed racer, Tamamo Cross. She is White Lightning—a storm the likes of which none have seen before—and now she stands proud, at the peak of her prowess.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: This is Tama—No… this is Tamamo Cross.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Do I even have what it takes to race against this Tamamo Cross? I'm… I'm…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I'm so happy! And excited!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I want to win—I will win! I… I have to!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Heh, figured you'd say as much. That's what makes you the "Beast." And that's why I respect ya, Oguri…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Taking Tamamo Cross's stirring comments on board, Oguri Cap's entire body begins trembling with excitement.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Now keep your eyes peeled for some once-in-a-lifetime lightnin'. Today, at the Arima Kinen, the grand finale…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna be the wind and the light!
